nodes.en: Automatic array variables are not stored in registers.【1】【2】1【/2】【/1】 Instead, they are stored into the thread’s local memory and may incur long access delays and potential access congestions. The scope of these arrays, like that of automatic scalar variables, is limited to individual threads. That is, a private version of each automatic array is created for and used by every thread. Once a thread terminates its execution, the contents of its automatic array variables cease to exist. From our experience, one seldom needs to use automatic array variables in kernel functions and device functions.
nodes.zh: 自动数组变量不会存放在寄存器中。【1】【2】1【/2】【/1】相反，它们被存入线程的局部内存，可能会带来较长的访问延迟和潜在的访问拥塞。这些数组的作用域与自动标量变量一样，局限于各个线程。也就是说，每个线程都会创建并使用每个自动数组的一个私有版本。一旦线程结束执行，其自动数组变量的内容就不复存在。根据我们的经验，在核函数和设备函数中很少需要使用自动数组变量。

nodes.en: If a variable declaration is preceded by the 【1】__shared__【/1】 keyword (each “__’’ consists of two “_’’ characters), it declares a shared variable in CUDA. One can also add an optional 【2】__device__【/2】 in front of 【3】__shared__【/3】 in the declaration to achieve the same effect. Such a declaration is typically made within a kernel function or a device function. Shared variables reside in the shared memory. The scope of a shared variable is within a thread block; that is, all threads in a block see the same version of a shared variable. A private version of the shared variable is created for and used by each block during kernel execution. The lifetime of a shared variable is within the duration of the kernel execution. When a kernel terminates its grid’s execution, the contents of its shared variables cease to exist. As we discussed earlier, shared variables are an efficient means for threads within a block to collaborate with each other. Accessing shared variables from the shared memory is extremely fast and highly parallel. CUDA programmers often use shared variables to hold the portion of global memory data that is frequently used and reused in an execution phase of the kernel. One may need to adjust the algorithms that are used to create execution phases that heavily focus on small portions of the global memory data, as we will demonstrate with matrix multiplication in 【4】Section 5.4【/4】.
nodes.zh: 如果变量声明前带有【1】__shared__【/1】关键字（每个“__”由两个“_”字符组成），就在 CUDA 中声明了一个共享变量。也可以在声明中把可选的【2】__device__【/2】加到【3】__shared__【/3】前面，以达到相同的效果。这种声明通常在核函数或设备函数中进行。共享变量存放在共享内存中。共享变量的作用域限于一个线程块内；也就是说，一个线程块中的所有线程看到的是共享变量的同一个版本。在核函数执行期间，每个线程块都会创建并使用共享变量的一个私有版本。共享变量的生命周期与核函数执行的持续时间一致。当一个核函数结束其网格的执行时，其共享变量的内容就不复存在。正如我们前面讨论过的，共享变量是线程块内线程相互协作的一种高效手段。从共享内存访问共享变量非常快，而且高度并行。CUDA 程序员经常使用共享变量来保存在核函数的某个执行阶段中被频繁使用和复用的那部分全局内存数据。可能需要调整算法，以创建高度聚焦于全局内存数据小部分的执行阶段，正如我们将用【4】第 5.4 节【/4】中的矩阵乘法所演示的那样。

nodes.en: If a variable declaration is preceded by keyword 【1】__constant__【/1】’ (each “__’’ consists of two “_’’ characters), it declares a constant variable in CUDA. One can also add an optional 【2】__device__【/2】 in front of 【3】__constant__【/3】 to achieve the same effect. Declaration of constant variables must be outside any function body. The scope of a constant variable is all grids, meaning that all threads in all grids see the same version of a constant variable. The lifetime of a constant variable is the entire application execution. Constant variables are often used for variables that provide input values to kernel functions. The values of the constant variables cannot be changed by the kernel function code. Constant variables are stored in the global memory but are cached for efficient access. With appropriate access patterns, accessing constant memory is extremely fast and parallel. Currently, the total size of constant variables in an application is limited to 65,536 bytes. One may need to break up the input data volume to fit within this limitation. We will demonstrate the usage of constant memory in 【4】Chapter 7【/4】, Convolution.
nodes.zh: 如果变量声明前带有【1】__constant__【/1】关键字（每个“__”由两个“_”字符组成），就在 CUDA 中声明了一个常量变量。也可以在声明中把可选的【2】__device__【/2】加到【3】__constant__【/3】前面，以达到相同的效果。常量变量的声明必须在任何函数体之外。常量变量的作用域覆盖所有网格，也就是说，所有网格中的所有线程看到的是同一个常量变量版本。常量变量的生命周期覆盖整个应用的执行。常量变量通常用于为核函数提供输入值的变量。核函数代码不能改变常量变量的值。常量变量存放在全局内存中，但会被缓存以便高效访问。在适当的访问模式下，访问常量内存非常快且高度并行。目前，一个应用中常量变量的总大小被限制为 65,536 字节。可能需要拆分输入数据量，以适应这一限制。我们将在【4】第 7 章【/4】“卷积”中演示常量内存的使用。

nodes.en: A variable whose declaration is preceded only by the keyword 【1】__device__【/1】 (each “__’’ consists of two “_’’ characters) is a global variable and will be placed in the global memory. Accesses to a global variable are slow. Latency and throughput of accessing global variables have been improved with caches in more recent devices. One important advantage of global variables is that they are visible to all threads of all kernels. Their contents also persist through the entire execution. Thus global variables can be used as a means for threads to collaborate across blocks. However, one must be aware that there is currently no easy way to synchronize between threads from different thread blocks or to ensure data consistency across threads in accessing global memory other than using atomic operations or terminating the current kernel execution.【2】【3】2【/3】【/2】 Therefore global variables are often used to pass information from one kernel invocation to another kernel invocation.
nodes.zh: 一个变量，如果其声明只以关键字【1】__device__【/1】开头（每个“__”由两个“_”字符组成），就是全局变量，会被放在全局内存中。对全局变量的访问速度较慢。在较新的设备中，访问全局变量的延迟和吞吐量已通过缓存得到改善。全局变量的一个重要优点是：它对所有核函数的所有线程可见。它们的内容也会在整段执行期间持续存在。因此，全局变量可以作为线程跨线程块协作的手段。不过，必须注意：目前除了使用原子操作或终止当前核函数的执行之外，还没有简便的方法在不同线程块之间进行同步，或确保不同线程访问全局内存时数据的一致性。【2】【3】2【/3】【/2】因此，全局变量通常用于把信息从一个核函数调用传递到另一个核函数调用。

nodes.en: In CUDA, pointers can be used to point to data objects in the global memory. There are two typical ways in which pointer use arises in kernel and device functions. First, if an object is allocated by a host function, the pointer to the object is initialized by memory allocation API functions such as 【1】cudaMalloc【/1】 and can be passed to the kernel function as a parameter, as we saw in 【2】Chapter 2【/2】, Heterogeneous Data Parallel Computing, and 【3】Chapter 3【/3】, Multidimensional Grids and Data. The second type of use is to assign the address of a variable that is declared in the global memory to a pointer variable. For example, the statement 【4】{float* ptr=&GlobalVar;}【/4】 in a kernel function assigns the address of 【5】GlobalVar【/5】 into an automatic pointer variable 【6】ptr【/6】. The reader should refer to the CUDA Programming Guide for using pointers in other memory types.
nodes.zh: 在 CUDA 中，可以使用指针指向全局内存中的数据对象。在核函数和设备函数中，指针的使用通常有两种典型方式。第一种，如果对象由主机函数分配，指向对象的指针由内存分配 API 函数（如【1】cudaMalloc【/1】）初始化，并可以作为参数传给核函数，正如我们在【2】第 2 章【/2】“异构数据并行计算”和【3】第 3 章【/3】“多维网格与数据”中所见。第二种使用方式是，把在全局内存中声明的变量的地址赋给指针变量。例如，核函数中的语句【4】{float* ptr=&GlobalVar;}【/4】把【5】GlobalVar【/5】的地址赋给自动指针变量【6】ptr【/6】。读者应参考 CUDA Programming Guide，了解在其他内存类型中使用指针的方法。

nodes.en: 5.3 Tiling for reduced memory traffic
nodes.zh: 5.3 减少内存流量的分块

nodes.en: We have an intrinsic tradeoff in the use of device memories in CUDA: The global memory is large but slow, whereas the shared memory is small but fast. A common strategy is to partition the data into subsets called 【1】tiles【/1】 so that each tile fits into the shared memory. The term 【2】tile【/2】 draws on the analogy that a large wall (i.e., the global memory data) can be covered by small tiles (i.e., subsets that can each fit into the shared memory). An important criterion is that the kernel computation on these tiles can be done independently of each other. Note that not all data structures can be partitioned into tiles, given an arbitrary kernel function.
nodes.zh: 在 CUDA 中，使用设备内存存在一个内在的权衡：全局内存大但慢，而共享内存小但快。一种常见策略是把数据划分成称为【1】分块【/1】的子集，使每个分块都能放入共享内存。【2】分块【/2】一词借用了这样一个类比：一堵大墙（即全局内存数据）可以用小瓷砖（即每个都能放入共享内存的子集）铺满。一个重要的标准是，核函数对这些分块的计算可以相互独立地进行。注意，对于任意给定的核函数，并非所有数据结构都能划分成分块。

nodes.en: The concept of tiling can be illustrated with the matrix multiplication example from 【1】Chapter 3【/1】, Multidimensional Grids and Data. 【2】Fig. 3.13【/2】 showed a small example of matrix multiplication. It corresponds to the kernel function in 【3】Fig. 3.11【/3】. We replicate the example in 【4】Fig. 5.5【/4】 for convenient reference. For brevity we abbreviate P[y*Width+x], M[y*Width+x], and N[y*Width+x] into P【5】y,x【/5】, M【6】y,x【/6】, and N【7】y,x【/7】, respectively. This example assumes that we use four × 2 blocks to compute the P matrix. The heavy boxes in the P matrix define the P elements that are processed by each block. 【8】Fig. 5.5【/8】 highlights the computation done by the four threads of block【9】0,0【/9】. These four threads compute P【10】0,0【/10】, P【11】0,1【/11】, P【12】1,0【/12】, and P【13】1,1【/13】. The accesses to the M and N elements by thread【14】0,0【/14】 and thread【15】0,1【/15】 of block【16】0,0【/16】 are highlighted with black arrows. For example, thread【17】0,0【/17】 reads M【18】0,0【/18】 and N【19】0,0【/19】, followed by M【20】0,1【/20】 and N【21】1,0【/21】, followed by M【22】0,2【/22】 and N【23】2,0【/23】, followed by M【24】0,3【/24】 and N【25】3,0【/25】.
nodes.zh: 分块的概念可以用【1】第 3 章【/1】“多维网格与数据”中的矩阵乘法示例来说明。【2】图 3.13【/2】展示了一个小的矩阵乘法示例，它对应于【3】图 3.11【/3】中的核函数。我们在【4】图 5.5【/4】中复现了这个示例，方便查阅。为简洁起见，我们把 P[y*Width+x]、M[y*Width+x] 和 N[y*Width+x] 分别简写为 P【5】y,x【/5】、M【6】y,x【/6】和 N【7】y,x【/7】。这个示例假设我们使用四个 2×2 的线程块来计算 P 矩阵。P 矩阵中的粗线方框标明了每个线程块处理的 P 元素。【8】图 5.5【/8】突出了线程块【9】0,0【/9】的四个线程所完成的计算。这四个线程计算 P【10】0,0【/10】、P【11】0,1【/11】、P【12】1,0【/12】和 P【13】1,1【/13】。线程块【14】0,0【/14】的线程【15】0,0【/15】和线程【16】0,1【/16】对 M 和 N 元素的访问用黑色箭头标出。例如，线程【17】0,0【/17】读取 M【18】0,0【/18】和 N【19】0,0【/19】，接着读取 M【20】0,1【/20】和 N【21】1,0【/21】，再读取 M【22】0,2【/22】和 N【23】2,0【/23】，最后读取 M【24】0,3【/24】和 N【25】3,0【/25】。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 5.5【/1】 A small example of matrix multiplication. For brevity we show M[y*Width+x], N[y*Width+x], P[y*Width+x] as M【2】y,x【/2】, N【3】y,x【/3】 P【4】y,x【/4】, respectively.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 5.5【/1】 一个小的矩阵乘法示例。为简洁起见，我们把 M[y*Width+x]、N[y*Width+x]、P[y*Width+x] 分别表示为 M【2】y,x【/2】、N【3】y,x【/3】和 P【4】y,x【/4】。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 5.6【/1】 shows the global memory accesses done by all threads in block【2】0,0【/2】. The threads are listed in the vertical direction, with time of access increasing from left to right in the horizontal direction. Note that each thread accesses four elements of M and four elements of N during its execution. Among the four threads highlighted, there is a significant overlap in the M and N elements that they access. For example, thread【3】0,0【/3】 and thread【4】0,1【/4】 both access M【5】0,0【/5】 as well as the rest of row 0 of M. Similarly, thread【6】0,1【/6】 and thread【7】1,1【/7】 both access N【8】0,1【/8】 as well as the rest of column 1 of N.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 5.6【/1】展示了线程块【2】0,0【/2】中所有线程完成的全局内存访问。线程沿垂直方向列出，访问时间沿水平方向从左向右递增。注意，每个线程在执行期间都要访问 M 的四个元素和 N 的四个元素。在被突出的四个线程中，它们访问的 M 和 N 元素有相当大的重叠。例如，线程【3】0,0【/3】和线程【4】0,1【/4】都访问 M【5】0,0【/5】以及 M 第 0 行的其余元素。同样，线程【6】0,1【/6】和线程【7】1,1【/7】都访问 N【8】0,1【/8】以及 N 第 1 列的其余元素。

nodes.en: 【1】【2】Figure 5.6【/2】【/1】 Global memory accesses performed by threads in block【3】0,0【/3】.

The kernel in 【1】Fig. 3.11【/1】 is written so that both thread【2】0,0【/2】 and thread【3】0,1【/3】 access row 0 elements of M from the global memory. If we can somehow manage to have thread【4】0,0【/4】 and thread【5】0,1【/5】 collaborate so that these M elements are loaded from global memory only once, we can reduce the total number of accesses to the global memory by half. In fact, we can see that every M and N element is accessed exactly twice during the execution of block【6】0,0【/6】. Therefore if we can have all four threads collaborate in their accesses to global memory, we can reduce the traffic to the global memory by half.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 3.11【/1】中的核函数的编写方式是：线程【2】0,0【/2】和线程【3】0,1【/3】都从全局内存访问 M 的第 0 行元素。如果我们能以某种方式让线程【4】0,0【/4】和线程【5】0,1【/5】协作，使这些 M 元素只从全局内存加载一次，就可以把对全局内存的访问总次数减少一半。事实上，我们可以看到，在线程块【6】0,0【/6】的执行过程中，每个 M 和 N 元素都恰好被访问两次。因此，如果我们能让这四个线程在访问全局内存时相互协作，就可以把全局内存流量减少一半。

nodes.en: The reader should verify that the potential reduction in global memory traffic in the matrix multiplication example is proportional to the dimension of the blocks that are used. With Width×Width blocks, the potential reduction of global memory traffic would be Width. That is, if we use 16×16 blocks, we can potentially reduce the global memory traffic to 1/16 of the original level through collaboration between threads.
nodes.zh: 读者应该验证：在矩阵乘法示例中，全局内存流量的潜在减少量与所用线程块的维数成正比。使用 Width×Width 的线程块时，全局内存流量的潜在减少量可达到 Width 倍。也就是说，如果我们使用 16×16 的线程块，通过线程之间的协作，就可以把全局内存流量潜在减少到原来的 1/16。

nodes.en: We now present a tiled matrix multiplication algorithm. The basic idea is to have the threads collaboratively load subsets of the M and N elements into the shared memory before they individually use these elements in their dot product calculation. Keep in mind that the size of the shared memory is quite small, and one must be careful not to exceed the capacity of the shared memory when loading these M and N elements into the shared memory. This can be accomplished by dividing the M and N matrices into smaller tiles. The size of these tiles is chosen so that they can fit into the shared memory. In the simplest form, the tile dimensions equal those of the block, as illustrated in 【1】Fig. 5.7【/1】.
nodes.zh: 我们现在介绍一种分块矩阵乘法算法。其基本思想是：在线程各自把这些 M 和 N 元素用于点积计算之前，让线程们协作地把 M 和 N 元素的子集加载到共享内存中。要记住，共享内存的容量相当小，在把这些 M 和 N 元素加载到共享内存时，必须小心不要超出共享内存的容量。这可以通过把 M 和 N 矩阵划分成更小的分块来实现。这些分块的大小要选择得能放入共享内存。在最简单的形式中，分块的维数与线程块的维数相等，如【1】图 5.7【/1】所示。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 5.7【/1】 Tiling M and N to utilize shared memory.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 5.7【/1】 对 M 和 N 进行分块以利用共享内存。

nodes.en: In 【1】Fig. 5.7【/1】 we divide M and N into 2×2 tiles, as delineated by the thick lines. The dot product calculations that are performed by each thread are now divided into phases. In each phase, all threads in a block collaborate to load a tile of M and a tile of N into the shared memory. This can be done by having every thread in a block load one M element and one N element into the shared memory, as illustrated in 【2】Fig. 5.8【/2】. Each row of 【3】Fig. 5.8【/3】 shows the execution activities of a thread. Note that time progresses from left to right. We need to show only the activities of threads in block【4】0,0【/4】; the other blocks all have the same behavior. The shared memory array for the M elements is called Mds. The shared memory array for the N elements is called Nds. At the beginning of phase 1, the four threads of block【5】0,0【/5】 collaboratively load a tile of M into shared memory: Thread【6】0,0【/6】 loads M【7】0,0【/7】 into Mds【8】0,0【/8】, thread【9】0,1【/9】 loads M【10】0,1【/10】 into Mds【11】0,1【/11】, thread【12】1,0【/12】 loads M【13】1,0【/13】 into Mds【14】1,0【/14】, and thread【15】1,1【/15】 loads M【16】1,1【/16】 into Mds【17】1,1【/17】. These loads are shown in the second column of 【18】Fig. 5.8【/18】. A tile of N is also loaded in a similar manner, shown in the third column of 【19】Fig. 5.8【/19】.
nodes.zh: 在【1】图 5.7【/1】中，我们按照粗线所划分的那样，把 M 和 N 分成 2×2 的分块。每个线程执行的点积计算现在被划分成多个阶段。在每个阶段中，线程块中的所有线程协作，把一个 M 分块和一个 N 分块加载到共享内存中。这可以通过让线程块中的每个线程把一个 M 元素和一个 N 元素加载到共享内存来实现，如【2】图 5.8【/2】所示。【3】图 5.8【/3】的每一行展示一个线程的执行活动。注意，时间从左向右推进。我们只需要展示线程块【4】0,0【/4】中线程的活动；其他线程块的行为完全相同。用于 M 元素的共享内存数组称为 Mds，用于 N 元素的共享内存数组称为 Nds。在阶段 1 开始时，线程块【5】0,0【/5】的四个线程协作地把一个 M 分块加载到共享内存：线程【6】0,0【/6】把 M【7】0,0【/7】加载到 Mds【8】0,0【/8】，线程【9】0,1【/9】把 M【10】0,1【/10】加载到 Mds【11】0,1【/11】，线程【12】1,0【/12】把 M【13】1,0【/13】加载到 Mds【14】1,0【/14】，线程【15】1,1【/15】把 M【16】1,1【/16】加载到 Mds【17】1,1【/17】。这些加载显示在【18】图 5.8【/18】的第二列。一个 N 分块也以类似方式加载，显示在【19】图 5.8【/19】的第三列。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 5.8【/1】 Execution phases of a tiled matrix multiplication.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 5.8【/1】 分块矩阵乘法的执行阶段。

nodes.en: After the two tiles of M and N are loaded into the shared memory, these elements are used in the calculation of the dot product. Note that each value in the shared memory is used twice. For example, the M【1】1,1【/1】 value, loaded by thread【2】1,1【/2】 into Mds【3】1,1【/3】, is used twice, once by thread【4】1,0【/4】 and once by thread【5】1,1【/5】. By loading each global memory value into shared memory so that it can be used multiple times, we reduce the number of accesses to the global memory. In this case, we reduce the number of accesses to the global memory by a factor of 2. The reader should verify that the reduction is by a factor of N if the tiles are N×N elements.
nodes.zh: 在两个 M 和 N 分块被加载到共享内存之后，这些元素就被用于点积的计算。注意，共享内存中的每个值都被使用两次。例如，由线程【2】1,1【/2】加载到 Mds【3】1,1【/3】的 M【1】1,1【/1】值被使用两次，一次由线程【4】1,0【/4】使用，一次由线程【5】1,1【/5】使用。通过把每个全局内存值加载到共享内存，使它可以被多次使用，我们减少了访问全局内存的次数。在这种情况下，访问全局内存的次数减少了一半。读者应该验证：如果分块是 N×N 个元素，减少量就是 N 倍。

nodes.en: Note that the calculation of each dot product is now performed in two phases, shown as phase 1 and phase 2 in 【1】Fig. 5.8【/1】. In each phase, each thread accumulates products of two pairs of the input matrix elements into the Pvalue variable. Note that Pvalue is an automatic variable, so a private version is generated for each thread. We added subscripts just to clarify that these are different instances of the Pvalue variable created for each thread. The first phase calculation is shown in the fourth column of 【2】Fig. 5.8【/2】, and the second phase is shown in the seventh column. In general, if an input matrix is of dimension 【3】Width【/3】 and the tile size is 【4】TILE_WIDTH【/4】, the dot product would be performed in 【5】Width/TILE_WIDTH【/5】 phases. The creation of these phases is key to the reduction of accesses to the global memory. With each phase focusing on a small subset of the input matrix values, the threads can collaboratively load the subset into the shared memory and use the values in the shared memory to satisfy their overlapping input needs in the phase.
nodes.zh: 注意，每个点积的计算现在分两个阶段进行，即【1】图 5.8【/1】中的阶段 1 和阶段 2。在每个阶段中，每个线程把两对输入矩阵元素的乘积累加到 Pvalue 变量中。注意，Pvalue 是自动变量，所以会为每个线程生成一个私有版本。我们加上下标只是为了说明这些是为每个线程创建的 Pvalue 变量的不同实例。第一阶段的计算显示在【2】图 5.8【/2】的第四列，第二阶段显示在第七列。一般来说，如果输入矩阵的维数为【3】Width【/3】，分块大小为【4】TILE_WIDTH【/4】，那么点积将分【5】Width/TILE_WIDTH【/5】个阶段进行。这些阶段的形成是减少对全局内存访问的关键。由于每个阶段聚焦于输入矩阵值的一个小子集，线程们可以协作地把该子集加载到共享内存，并用共享内存中的值来满足本阶段相互重叠的输入需求。

nodes.en: Note also that Mds and Nds are reused across phases. In each phase, the same Mds and Nds are reused to hold the subset of M and N elements used in the phase. This allows a much smaller shared memory to serve most of the accesses to global memory. This is because each phase focuses on a small subset of the input matrix elements. Such focused access behavior is called 【1】locality【/1】. When an algorithm exhibits locality, there is an opportunity to use small, high-speed memories to serve most of the accesses and remove these accesses from the global memory. Locality is as important for achieving high performance in multicore CPUs as in many-thread GPUs We will return to the concept of locality in 【2】Chapter 6【/2】, Performance Considerations.
nodes.zh: 还要注意，Mds 和 Nds 会在各阶段之间复用。在每个阶段，相同的 Mds 和 Nds 被复用来存放该阶段用到的 M 和 N 元素子集。这样，小得多的共享内存就可以满足大部分对全局内存的访问。这是因为每个阶段都聚焦于输入矩阵元素的一个小子集。这种聚焦的访问行为称为【1】数据局部性【/1】。当一个算法表现出数据局部性时，就有机会使用小而高速的内存来满足大部分访问，把这些访问从全局内存中移除。数据局部性对于在多核 CPU 上取得高性能，与在多线程 GPU 上一样重要。我们将在【2】第 6 章【/2】“性能考量”中回到数据局部性这一概念。

nodes.en: 5.4 A tiled matrix multiplication kernel
nodes.zh: 5.4 分块矩阵乘法核函数

nodes.en: We are now ready to present a tiled matrix multiplication kernel that uses shared memory to reduce traffic to the global memory. The kernel shown in 【1】Fig. 5.9【/1】 implements the phases illustrated in 【2】Fig. 5.8【/2】. In 【3】Fig. 5.9【/3】, lines 04 and 05 declare 【4】Mds【/4】 and 【5】Nds【/5】, respectively, as shared memory arrays. Recall that the scope of shared memory variables is a block. Thus one version of the 【6】Mds【/6】 and 【7】Nds【/7】 arrays will be created for each block, and all threads of a block have access to the same 【8】Mds【/8】 and 【9】Nds【/9】 version. This is important because all threads in a block must have access to the M and N elements that are loaded into 【10】Mds【/10】 and 【11】Nds【/11】 by their peers so that they can use these values to satisfy their input needs.
nodes.zh: 我们现在准备介绍一个使用共享内存来减少全局内存流量的分块矩阵乘法核函数。【1】图 5.9【/1】所示的核函数实现了【2】图 5.8【/2】中说明的阶段。在【3】图 5.9【/3】中，第 04 行和第 05 行分别把【4】Mds【/4】和【5】Nds【/5】声明为共享内存数组。回忆一下，共享内存变量的作用域是一个线程块。因此，每个线程块都会创建一组【6】Mds【/6】和【7】Nds【/7】数组，线程块中的所有线程都可以访问同一个【8】Mds【/8】和【9】Nds【/9】版本。这一点很重要，因为线程块中的所有线程都必须能够访问由同伴加载到【10】Mds【/10】和【11】Nds【/11】中的 M 和 N 元素，以便用这些值满足自己的输入需求。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 5.9【/1】 A tiled matrix multiplication kernel using shared memory.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 5.9【/1】 使用共享内存的分块矩阵乘法核函数。

nodes.en: Lines 07 and 08 save the 【1】threadIdx【/1】 and 【2】blockIdx【/2】 values into automatic variables with shorter names to make the code more concise. Recall that automatic scalar variables are placed into registers. Their scope is in each individual thread. That is, one private version of 【3】tx【/3】, 【4】ty【/4】, 【5】bx【/5】, and 【6】by【/6】 is created by the runtime system for each thread and will reside in registers that are accessible by the thread. They are initialized with the 【7】threadIdx【/7】 and 【8】blockIdx【/8】 values and used many times during the lifetime of thread. Once the thread ends, the values of these variables cease to exist.
nodes.zh: 第 07 行和第 08 行把【1】threadIdx【/1】和【2】blockIdx【/2】的值保存到名称更短的自动变量中，使代码更简洁。回忆一下，自动标量变量会被放入寄存器。它们的作用域在单个线程内。也就是说，运行时系统会为每个线程创建【3】tx【/3】、【4】ty【/4】、【5】bx【/5】和【6】by【/6】各一个私有版本，它们位于该线程可访问的寄存器中。这些变量用【7】threadIdx【/7】和【8】blockIdx【/8】的值初始化，并在线程的生命周期内被多次使用。线程一旦结束，这些变量的值就不复存在。

nodes.en: Lines 11 and 12 determine the row index and column index, respectively, of the P element that the thread is to produce. The code assumes that each thread is responsible for calculating one P element. As shown in line 12, the horizontal (x) position, or the column index of the P element to be produced by a thread, can be calculated as 【1】bx*TILE_WIDTH+tx【/1】. This is because each block covers 【2】TILE_WIDTH【/2】 elements of P in the horizontal dimension. A thread in block 【3】bx【/3】 would have before it 【4】bx【/4】 blocks of threads, or 【5】(bx*TILE_WIDTH)【/5】 threads; they cover 【6】bx*TILE_WIDTH【/6】 elements of P. Another 【7】tx【/7】 thread within the same block would cover another 【8】tx【/8】 elements. Thus the thread with 【9】bx【/9】 and 【10】tx【/10】 should be responsible for calculating the P element whose x index is 【11】bx*TILE_WIDTH+tx【/11】. For the example in 【12】Fig. 5.7【/12】, the horizontal (x) index of the P element to be calculated by thread【13】0,1【/13】 of block【14】1,0【/14】 is 0*2+1=1. This horizontal index is saved in the variable 【15】Col【/15】 for the thread and is also illustrated in 【16】Fig. 5.10【/16】.
nodes.zh: 第 11 行和第 12 行分别确定线程要生成的 P 元素的行索引和列索引。代码假设每个线程负责计算一个 P 元素。如第 12 行所示，线程要生成的 P 元素的水平（x）位置，即列索引，可以计算为【1】bx*TILE_WIDTH+tx【/1】。这是因为每个线程块在水平方向上覆盖 P 的【2】TILE_WIDTH【/2】个元素。线程块【3】bx【/3】中的一个线程，前面有【4】bx【/4】个线程块，即【5】(bx*TILE_WIDTH)【/5】个线程；它们覆盖 P 的【6】bx*TILE_WIDTH【/6】个元素。同一线程块中的另外【7】tx【/7】个线程会再覆盖【8】tx【/8】个元素。因此，具有【9】bx【/9】和【10】tx【/10】的线程应负责计算 x 索引为【11】bx*TILE_WIDTH+tx【/11】的 P 元素。以【12】图 5.7【/12】中的示例为例，线程块【13】1,0【/13】中线程【14】0,1【/14】要计算的 P 元素的水平（x）索引为 0*2+1=1。这个水平索引被保存在该线程的变量【15】Col【/15】中，也在【16】图 5.10【/16】中作了说明。
